validation_status.optimal_ranges: based on standard clinical references + Mark canonical adjustments

two_zonal_structure: Above optimal = excess quality (часто pathology — например polycythemia)
Below optimal = deficient quality (часто pathology — например anemia)
general_principle.quality_not_monotonic: Quality не равно «выше/ниже = лучше/хуже». Quality имеет optimal point, и отклонения в обе стороны — pathological.

interpretation_note: Part F не является diagnostic algorithm. Это structured hypothesis space для оценки quality каждой энергии через clinically routine biomarkers.
Применение требует: clinical correlation; multiple marker patterns (not single value); age/gender adjustment; medication context; validation across documented cases.

markers.deficient_quality: <0.5 mg/L (very low — может быть subclinical immune suppression)
<50 bpm (athletes ok, otherwise marker of bradyarrhythmia)

clinical_interpretation_patterns.high_quantity_low_quality: Выраженные thermal symptoms (warmth, sweating, irritability) + functional markers ниже optimal. Пример: chronic inflammation pattern, hsCRP up, гемоглобин low (anemia of chronic disease).
clinical_interpretation_patterns.low_quantity_low_quality: Тихий thermal pattern + функционально страдает. Пример: severe anemia, hypothyroid, frail elderly. Heat в дефиците по обоим axes.
clinical_interpretation_patterns.high_quantity_high_quality: Strong thermal output + хороший CV/inflammation status. Это pathological excess — острая heat, инфекция, или гиперметаболизм.
clinical_interpretation_patterns.low_quantity_high_quality: Тихая, но clean heat. Часто normal healthy aging — снижение overall energy без inflammatory/anemic patterns. Не требует intervention.

clinical_interpretation_patterns.high_quality_excess_quantity: Active hepatobiliary process — hepatitis acute, biliary colic, severe migraine. Часто manifest patterns of Wood-Earth disharmony (irritability + digestive symptoms).
clinical_interpretation_patterns.deficient_wind_quality: Clinically rare — обычно проявляется как pseudonormal labs при actual functional liver insufficiency (CYP underperformance, conjugation problems). Не all liver dysfunction рефлектируется в standard panel.

markers.deficient_quality: <50 (very low — может быть marker hypothyroid или malabsorption)

clinical_interpretation_patterns.high_quantity_dirty_quality: Classic metabolic syndrome — high glucose, high insulin, high TG, large waist, fatty liver. Это Yang-Earth excess accumulation pattern.
clinical_interpretation_patterns.low_damp_dirty_quality: Paradoxical — thin but metabolically dysfunctional (TOFI — «thin outside, fat inside»). Asian phenotype с visceral fat без overt obesity.

clinical_interpretation_patterns.high_dry_quality_excess_quantity: Paradoxical — usually означает Excess Dry — это fibrotic process. PBC, IPF, scleroderma, chronic glomerulopathy. Это PCL-B phase patterns.
clinical_interpretation_patterns.low_dry_quality: Часто manifests как mucosal symptoms — dry mouth, dry eyes (Sjogren overlap), constipation. Это often combined deficient Lung-Metal pattern.

clinical_interpretation_patterns.high_quantity_low_quality: Severe Yang deficit — frail elderly, hypothyroid pattern, osteoporosis, low energy, cold intolerance. Это Yin-Water dominant constitution в pathology.
clinical_interpretation_patterns.deficient_cold: Hyperthyroid pattern, hot flashes, irritability, weight loss. Может быть Yang-Fire excess, но через Cold deficiency mechanism.

multi_energy_markers.interpretation: Energy axis (acid = Heat, alkaline = Cold/Dry, per Mark canonical)
Wind × Cold (immune system, Kidney-jing related в TCM)
Heat × Damp + Mark canonical Yin-Fire phenotype marker

cardiovascular_metabolic: Cold markers (TSH, cortisol, testosterone у M)
cross-reference: phase angle BIA, uric acid
autoimmune_inflammatory: Dry markers (если fibrotic component — KL-6, procollagen III)
energy_fatigue: Cold markers (TSH, cortisol, vit D, testosterone)
pre_oncology_screening_mark_phenotype: cross-reference: uric acid (gout / metabolic / Yin-Fire phenotype)

limitations: Single biomarker — never diagnostic. Quality assessment требует pattern across multiple markers.
Reference ranges vary по lab — использовать local lab references, not absolute numbers.
Optimal ≠ normal. Optimal range narrower чем «lab normal» range (например TSH «normal» 0.5-4.5, но optimal часто 0.5-2.5).
Age и gender adjustment критичны для multiple markers (testosterone, DHEA, hemoglobin).
Acute vs chronic elevation/depression — clinical correlation always needed.
Medication effects — many биомаркеры влияют от текущих препаратов. Документировать medication list при оценке.
Quality assessment ≠ diagnosis. Это один из контекстов в clinical reasoning, не замена ICD-based dx.
open_questions: Какие markers лучше всего predict drug response patterns?
Существуют ли pattern signatures, которые предсказывают titration tolerance (как в semaglutide наблюдении Mark)?
Можно ли построить «quality score» для каждой энергии на основе weighted combination biomarkers?
Inter-rater reliability — будут ли два METACOD-trained клинициста соглашаться в quality assessment одного пациента based on identical lab panel?
